name: LeadIQ MCP
description:
LeadIQ brings verified B2B contact and company data into Claude.

Look up people you already know by name and company, work email, or LinkedIn URL. You get verified work emails, direct dials, title, seniority, and
employer details for up to 10 people per request. Look up companies by domain, name, or LinkedIn to see firmographics, tech stack, revenue, 
funding history, and NAICS/SIC codes.

To find new leads, search with filters such as title, seniority, role, industry, company size, revenue, funding, location, and technology stack. 
Results come back as a working list of people. You can also build account lists with full firmographics for ABM, and spot job changes and 
promotions to reach past champions soon after they land in a new role.

When you find someone worth pursuing, save them to a LeadIQ prospect list, verify their email before you send, and export them to Salesforce as a 
Lead or Contact. Exports run through the same pipeline as the LeadIQ web app and check for duplicates first.

The whole prospecting loop stays in one conversation, from finding leads to planning outreach. And since LeadIQ is an MCP connector, results flow 
into any other tool you have connected to Claude.

Costs stay visible. Claude tells you the credit cost of paid lookups before running them and asks before large ones, and you can check your balance
and per-field rates at any time. Requires a LeadIQ account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LeadIQ MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LeadIQ MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.leadiq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LeadIQ MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LeadIQ MCP lists 17 MCP tools, including AddProspectToList, AttachProspectToList, BrowseProspectLists, CheckCredits, CreateProspect, CreateProspectList, EnrichCompanies, EnrichPeople, ExportProspectToSalesforce, FindCompanies, FindJobChanges, and FindPeople.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LeadIQ MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LeadIQ MCP in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does LeadIQ MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: LeadIQ MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LeadIQ MCP is developed by LeadIQ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
